x: Perhaps the performance which gave us most pleasure was that of our team (Bird, Botwright, Jarlett & Pack) in taking second place in the A.A.A. 4 x 440 yards Relay Championship to Achilles A.C.
…hursdays, gasping behind Linstead, Dabbs, Gebbett & Co. as they did the "seven hills"; sometimes on the "Warren 9" with Bird, Walker, Baulch & Co.…
Bird, Botwright, Jarlett and Pack, with Achilles AC being the victors. Unfortunately there appears to be little hope of emulating these performances until some new 400 metre talent emerges.
This is the first time we have ever been placed and Messrs. Pack, Michael, Herbert and Bird will value their bronze medals.
